system.stale_heartbeat_note: a heartbeat older than 180s is reported as stale rather than as healthy: the last thing a crashed lab does is stop updating

tiers.retention: 2.0 h behind the writer, then compacted

strategy_lab.research_cannot_change_a_running_strateg: the PAPER runtime snapshots its strategy map at startup; regenerating the ledger while it runs cannot alter decisions it has already loaded

retention.preservation: raw is deleted only after M-03 and M-07 are shown to survive compaction at the preregistered resolution

graceful_stop.method: the supervisor writes each child's stop file, waits for it to seal and finalise, and only then terminates the ones that did not exit

plan.no_live_path: children are read-only market data plus the PAPER broker; no child holds execution credentials

blocking: sample is 12.0 min; 24 h of clean capture is the minimum to begin
M-03.collector_running_is_not_readiness: readiness is derived from coverage, quality and history in the quality report; a running collector is not evidence on its own

blocking: forward open interest spans 0.008 day(s); 6 day(s) are needed for a DEV/VAL/OOS split
M-07.collector_running_is_not_readiness: readiness is derived from coverage, quality and history in the quality report; a running collector is not evidence on its own

readiness_flags.note: these are independent: PAPER continuing while the collector is storage-blocked is a supported state (§22)

controls.why: the dashboard is an observability surface: a stop it could trigger is a stop a bug could trigger, and the lab must have exactly one operator path
